en.headline: Gratuity Eligibility Changed
en.hook: You might be eligible for gratuity even before 5 years of service
en.what: A recent court ruling has clarified that employees who resign before 5 years can still qualify for gratuity. The decision depends on actual working days and applicable provisions. Employees should not assume they are ineligible for gratuity if they leave before 5 years.
en.why: This ruling matters to young Indians as it affects their employment benefits. They should be aware of the Payment of Gratuity Act provisions to understand their eligibility.

ml.headline: 5 varsham munp illelum gratuity labhippikkenda
ml.hook: 5 varsham munp illelum gratuity labhicchuvennamennu manassila
ml.what: Uttaraadhikaranattinte thiriwal um gratuityyude yogyatha oru employee 5 varsham munp illel resign cheythaalum labhicchuvennamennu paripadiyunnatu. Niyamavum avashyakatakalum anusaarichu. 5 varsham munp illel resign cheythit randu employee gratuityyude yogyatha illa enn manassila
ml.why: Ithu yuvavargalude udheshikkunna avadhikalal sthira pankhilla. Avargal Payment of Gratuity Act-ile peedanamulla avadhikalam manassila
